name: Littlewild
description: The woodland showcase for the shared autonomous-life simulation.

presentation.title: Littlewild
presentation.worldSubtitle: A small world. So much possibility.

tutorial.title: A buddy, not a cursor
tutorial.body: Select Pip in the world or the roster. Their card opens beside them. You influence choices; you never move their paws.

tutorial.title: A small act of care
tutorial.body: Offer water or a snack from Pip’s own satchel. Watch the response in the world. When supplies run out, Pip gathers or visits the warehouse.

tutorial.title: Give knowledge room to grow
tutorial.body: Open Learn. Research and teach Woodland hands, then a first shelter lesson. Learning takes time and practice.

tutorial.title: A place to belong
tutorial.body: Open Build, place a leaf shelter on clear ground, and watch Pip gather and build. Completed homes are assigned automatically when a bed is available.

tutorial.title: Make a plan, not a chore
tutorial.body: Open the planner. Add a gathering goal and assign Pip. Try pause and resume. Essential self-care is protected; no items disappear when work is interrupted.

tutorial.title: Research a little further
tutorial.body: Guide levels open discoveries. Feature ranks unlock new research choices. Only researched recipes, blueprints and features appear in their normal menus.

tutorial.title: A little adventure
tutorial.body: Discover quests, prepare supplies and equipment, then send a companion. While away they leave the glade; only a recall is available. Successful returns earn prestige.

tutorial.title: A shared home, a wider world
tutorial.body: Spend prestige on a level-gated slot, prepare another bed, then welcome a friend with coins. Build a map table before buying adjacent islands. Each island shows its own level requirement and coin/prestige cost.

tutorial.title: Let the world do the carrying
tutorial.body: Only warehouse stock can be listed for sale. A creature carries it to a built market stall, then earns coins there. Workplace inputs and outputs also need physical trips.

tutorial.title: Keep your little world safe
tutorial.body: Export a story from Settings. A save includes the exact content definitions, homes, islands and unfinished work. Pause at any time; nothing advances while the game is closed.

tutorial.title: Chart your next shore
tutorial.body: Discover Shared cartography at guide level 3 with discovery rank 2. Build a map table, then use World map to compare island resources, level requirements and quests. Buying still needs land research, coins and prestige.
